source: The mathematical ZXNAME0000XZ C = AB does not describe any of this. The implementation schedule determines where tiles live, when they move, how many warps cooperate, and whether the expensive matrix units are continuously supplied. That gap between equation and execution is one of the central themes of AI systems engineering.
zh: 数学 ZXNAME0000XZ C = AB 没有描述任何这些。实施时间表决定了图块存在的位置、它们何时移动、有多少扭曲协作以及是否持续供应昂贵的矩阵单元。方程式和执行之间的差距是人工智能系统工程的中心主题之一。
